limitations: Supplemental betaine lowers plasma homocysteine in healthy adults, but that change does not measure tissue BHMT activity or show a clinical benefit. Human evidence is an eight-man depletion pilot, with the challenge response in four clinically depleted participants; tissue BHMT flux was not measured. Rat donor rescue and specific inhibition support the chain. This does not establish ordinary-diet limitation, response in every tissue or benefit above adequacy. Folate’s indirect constraint on BHMT remains unresolved.

records.biological_mechanism: Regulate the expression of cellular defence genes in response to oxidative and electrophilic stress.

food_evidence.evidence: Intensifying sulforaphane formation in broccoli sprouts (2018)
food_evidence.limitations: Sulforaphane forms from glucoraphanin when sprouts are chopped or chewed; preparation affects the amount.

limitations: Human target engagement varies by formulation, tissue and population. The positive study used a myrosinase-completed broccoli sprout homogenate for three days in healthy nonsmokers and measured nasal phase II enzyme RNA, not Nrf2 protein or nuclear translocation. Extract capsules did not increase lung target-gene expression in COPD. An ordinary broccoli meal, direct activation of Nrf2 in the human brain and clinical ADHD benefit remain unestablished. Sulforaphane is not an essential nutrient.
records.pm_mission: Regulate the expression of cellular defence genes in response to oxidative and electrophilic stress.
records.biological_operation: Modulates KEAP1-mediated control of Nrf2, promoting antioxidant-response gene transcription. Human dietary exposure increased Nrf2-associated phase II enzyme RNA in nasal lavage cells.

mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Cell engagement does not itself establish dietary exposure; human preparation evidence assessed separately.

limitation: Human target engagement varies by formulation, tissue and population. The positive study used a myrosinase-completed broccoli sprout homogenate for three days in healthy nonsmokers and measured nasal phase II enzyme RNA, not Nrf2 protein or nuclear translocation. Extract capsules did not increase lung target-gene expression in COPD. An ordinary broccoli meal, direct activation of Nrf2 in the human brain and clinical ADHD benefit remain unestablished. Sulforaphane is not an essential nutrient.

practices.pm_mission: Shape the rate of post-meal glucose appearance so metabolic and neuroendocrine systems face manageable, predictable load.
practices.input: Fish before rice in the studied meal sequence
practices.biological_role: Fish first delayed gastric emptying, an upstream control of carbohydrate delivery.
practices.limitation: An acute meal result; no claim that protein alone accounts for the effect.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Fish-before-rice comparison measured breath-test emptying and post-meal glucose responses.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Acute exploratory small study; meat comparison not the randomized crossover; no generic protein-first or chronic brain claim.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary abstract and full text.

practices.exposure_qualification: An acute meal result; no claim that protein alone accounts for the effect.

practices.pm_mission: Shape the rate of post-meal glucose appearance so metabolic and neuroendocrine systems face manageable, predictable load.
practices.input: The tested beta-glucan addition to a polenta meal
practices.biological_role: The studied 5 g beta-glucan addition redistributed exogenous glucose appearance from the first two hours to later in the six-hour period.
practices.limitation: Twelve overweight adults; no lower overall appearing quantity and no universal fibre effect. Viscosity is a proposed explanation, not a measured mediator.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: The tested beta-glucan/polenta meal redistributed isotope-estimated glucose appearance.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Specific 5-g addition in twelve overweight participants; no decrease in total appearance and no universal whole-oat equivalence.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary abstract.

practices.exposure_qualification: Twelve overweight adults; no lower overall appearing quantity and no universal fibre effect. Viscosity is a proposed explanation, not a measured mediator.

practices.pm_mission: Enable rapid ATP buffering so high-energy-demand tissues can meet sudden metabolic spikes.
practices.input: Limit unnecessary cumulative heat exposure when retaining creatine in pork products
practices.biological_role: Controlled pork-loin and cooked-ham experiments found greater creatine-to-creatinine conversion with higher heat exposure, especially at the product surface.
practices.limitation: Evidence is limited to processed pork matrices and does not establish higher creatine intake or cerebral target engagement.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Heating protocols altered creatine-to-creatinine conversion in pork/ham materials.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Composition retention only, not brain effects; no advice to undercook food.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary abstract; DOI 10.1021/jf801953t verifies correction of mismatched bibliography PMID.

practices.exposure_qualification: Composition-preservation practice in tested pork products only; preserve food safety, no brain-efficacy or undercooking advice.

practices.pm_mission: Regulate the expression of cellular defence genes in response to oxidative and electrophilic stress.
practices.biological_role: Three daily doses of broccoli sprouts, blended with water and daikon sprouts and held at 37°C so myrosinase could finish forming sulforaphane, increased phase II enzyme RNA in nasal cells of healthy adults. The authors read that shared pattern as Nrf2-linked induction. They did not measure Nrf2 protein or its movement into the nucleus.
practices.limitation: This is three days of that homogenate in healthy adults and nasal enzyme RNA, not brain Nrf2, an ordinary broccoli serving, or the four-week sprout-extract capsules that did not raise lung target-gene expression in COPD.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Defined broccoli-sprout homogenate raised nasal phase-II gene RNA relative to the control preparation.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Nasal target-gene response, not brain/ADHD effect, universal serving response or direct measurement of Nrf2 activation in every tissue.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary abstract; precise preparation retained from prior full source assessment.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: The COPD capsule trial did not increase the assessed Nrf2 target-gene endpoints.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Different tissue, disease and formulation; prevents a uniform exposure-response claim.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Existing assessed primary null; targeted recheck recorded separately.

practices.exposure_qualification: This is three days of that homogenate in healthy adults and nasal enzyme RNA, not brain Nrf2, an ordinary broccoli serving, or the four-week sprout-extract capsules that did not raise lung target-gene expression in COPD.

practices.pm_mission: Limit glycaemic volatility so post-prandial glucose swings do not create unnecessary metabolic and neuroendocrine stress.
practices.biological_role: In adults with type 2 diabetes, the tested less-processed whole-grain package reduced daily glucose standard deviation and mean amplitude of glycaemic excursions (MAGE) versus a nutrient-matched finely processed package over two weeks.
practices.limitation: A food package, not an isolated grain or fibre effect; unmasked foods, short duration. Concealed randomisation, blinded CGM, initial masked analysis and intention-to-treat models support appraisal.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Less-processed whole-grain package reduced CGM excursions and variability relative to finely milled nutrient-matched grains.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: 31 enrolled, 28 completed; two weeks; type 2 diabetes; combined oats/rice/bread package. Not an isolated fibre effect or brain outcome.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary paper abstract/results and existing source assessment compared; full methods where accessible.

practices.exposure_qualification: The less-milled whole-grain package is the exposure; not a biochemical dietary requirement or equivalent to adding isolated fibre.

practices.pm_mission: Limit glycaemic volatility so post-prandial glucose swings do not create unnecessary metabolic and neuroendocrine stress.
practices.input: Early eating with front-loaded calories (six-day trial)
practices.biological_role: In a small prediabetes crossover, the tested early, front-loaded eating schedule reduced mean amplitude of glycaemic excursions (MAGE) over six days versus later calorie distribution; mean glucose and several other variability/range measures were inconclusive.
practices.limitation: Small sample, no washout; timing, eating-window length and calorie distribution cannot be separated.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Six-day early eating with front-loaded calories reduced MAGE and hyperglycaemic exposure in ten adults with prediabetes.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Timing, window and calorie distribution were combined. Inflammatory markers and OGTT did not improve; short trial does not establish universal timing benefits.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary paper abstract/results and existing source assessment compared; full methods where accessible.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Early time restriction added to calorie restriction did not improve average glucose or insulin-sensitivity measures over calorie restriction alone.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Different 12-week protocol and overweight/obese population; incomplete CGM coverage. Retained as contrary context, not a second independent replication of Bruno.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary paper abstract/results and existing source assessment compared; full methods where accessible.
